newsitem.title: JAPAN: Biwako to brief media but says no financial worry.
newsitem.headline: Biwako to brief media but says no financial worry.

text.p: Biwako Bank Ltd said it would hold a news conference on Wednesday afternoon regarding impropriety by a former employee, but said there was no financial problem as a result of the incident.
It did not specify the nature of the impropriety.
An official at Biwako Bank, a Japanese regional bank in western Japan, said that he had not been informed when and where the news conference would be held.
However, the Osaka Securities Exchange said that the bank was planning to hold the news briefing there.
Earlier on Wednesday, another bank official said that Biwako was not suffering financial problems.
Asked about vague market talk that the bank may be facing difficulties, a Biwako Bank official told Reuters: "The rumours in the market are groundless."
Shares in Biwako Bank were sharply lower on Wednesday morning amid thin trade.
